text:
Sophia: Quick thread to finalize the Design Partner (DP) onboarding packet we send during recruitment. Goal: 1) short qualification form, 2) clear onboarding checklist for SEs, 3) a 1-page partner-facing summary, and 4) explicit launch acceptance criteria.

Matt: Good call. Want it concise — partners ignore long docs. Can you paste a candidate packet draft here?

Sophia: Draft below. Keep it tight, we can iterate.

```
DP Packet (draft):
- Intro & expectations (time commitment, roles)
- Quick qualification form (contact, volume, privacy level)
- Onboarding checklist for SEs (keys, SSO, test data)
- Supported integrations & required opt-in (Webhook / VPC / SSO)
- Feedback cadence (weekly 30m + async issue links)
- Success signals & telemetry access (what we need to see)
- Launch acceptance criteria & rollback conditions
- Credits / office hours offering
```

Elaine: Add gating rules: must have 1 internal champion (PM/Eng lead) and >=3mo commitment. If they have high data sensitivity, route to Private.

Kevin: From infra: add a smoke test requirement pre-launch. Something like: run 1,000 requests over 24h with 95p latency < target. We should provide a simple script snippet partners can run. Also state our response SLAs: ack tickets 24h biz, triage within 72h.

Oscar: For quality: include a monthly canonical prompt set (5 prompts per flow) and a transcripts upload location. We'll use that to track drift/regressions.

Jane: I'll design the 1-pager. Can we standardize the partner email + Notion destination? I can mock the layout.

Sophia: Proposed feedback template to include in packet: one-line summary, flows tested, repro steps + minimal prompt, expected vs actual, severity, impact, suggested fix. Keep it 6 lines.

Matt: Recruitment qual fields suggestion:
- Primary contact + role
- Monthly avg requests
- Primary use-case + 3 measurable success metrics
- Data sensitivity (low/med/high)
- Commitment length (3/6/12 mo)

Elaine: That looks good. We'll auto-filter high-sensitivity to Private track and require SE ops review.

Kevin: I'll paste a tiny smoke test snippet partners can run (bash + curl) and a table of tentative latency targets by model family in Notion.

Sophia: We also need a venue for structured feedback: create an issue label `dp-feedback` and a partner field. That makes prioritization traceable.

Elaine: I'll add the label and update the triage template. Also will own intake triage for the first month.

Matt: I'll draft the outreach email + 1-pager today and post to Notion at https://notion.redwood/team/dp-onboarding (will update link when ready).

Oscar: I'll finalize prompt sets and a simple rubric (correctness, hallucination, latency sensitivity). Will upload to the Notion folder.

Jane: Mock landed in Notion /Design-Partners/Assets. Sharing comments shortly.

Sophia: Important non-goal to state in the packet: we will not add ad-hoc features mid-beta except for critical safety or regression fixes. Helps manage scope creep.

Matt: Question: do we offer any incentives? Small credits + 2 technical office hours/month seems to work well historically.

Elaine: Agree. Keep monetary incentives for later-stage partners. Credits + office hours is fine.

dp-coordinator-bot: Reminder: DP weekly sync created for Tue 11:00 starting next week. Invites sent.

Kevin: Ops addendum: partners must select an integration path (Webhook, SSO, VPC) during intake. If they pick VPC we schedule a network review pre-launch.

Sophia: Recap / owners:
- Matt: outreach email + 1-pager (owner)
- Jane: visual one-pager mock
- Elaine: intake triage + issue labels
- Kevin: smoke test script + latency targets
- Oscar: prompt set + rubric
- Sophia: consolidate packet and final approval

Sophia: Proposed launch acceptance checklist (to include in packet):
- Partner sign-off recorded in Notion
- Smoke test run (1k requests / 24h) with 95p latency below target
- Error rate < 1% over 24h
- No critical regressions in canonical prompt set
- SE & partner agree to go-live window

Matt: LGTM. If we get these in Notion, can start outreach next week.

Elaine: I'll create the triage board items and label now.

Sophia: Action items (short):
- matt: post outreach email + packet link by EOD (1742003600)
- jane: upload one-pager mock
- kevin: drop smoke test script in Notion
- oscar: upload prompt set
- elaine: add dp-feedback label + run first intake

Matt: Will do. Ping here when complete.

Oscar: Uploaded prompts and rubric.

Jane: One-pager mock uploaded and shared.

Elaine: Labels created. First intake scheduled for Friday.

Sophia: Thanks everyone. We'll move ongoing edits to the Notion page; use this thread only for quick status notes. :thumbsup:

Matt: :thumbsup:
